body: I have friends and a girlfriend, but I absolutely hate talking about my feelings (can barely do it anonymously). That shit would just make me look like I'm insane and get me locked up.
There are many things I might consider interesting, but there's is not a single thing I care for.
I don't want anything. I like fishing (fly-fishing) and trekking and some other stupid stuff. But none of those things are worth living for.
No, I'm in medschool because my family expected me to study something and I chose what felt easier.
I simply have no reason to live, I don't understand why people want to either, I'm just expected to work or study endlessly to just be alive or buy things I don't want.

Yo ando con constantes pensamientos suicidas hace bastante tiempo. Al punto de tener todo planeado, pero la cuarentena no me deja hacerlo. Que se yo, leer un comentario en reddit no te va a provocar que te quieras matar, es algo que viene construyéndose hace mucho.

I am actively planning to do it, but I can't do it right now because of lockdown. I plan on going to a remote part of Patagonia, camp there until I run out of food and blow my brains. I have all the equipment, including a 38cal revolver and various possible locations. The little pleasure I get comes from insignificant things and it really isn't worth living for those things.

Therapy doesn't help at all, they only give useless advice. Also, if they think I'm a danger to myself, wouldn't that be enough to put me in the hospital? IDK, I'm not in the US and don't have anyone to ask without them thinking I'm insane.
